lastCompletedStory.title: Debt-marker gate: every TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX must cite a tracker id

nextStoryContext: Debt-marker gate live. Scans {src,scripts}/**/*.{ts,tsx} with Bun.Glob, excludes vendor/node_modules/claude-code-harness/dist/, classifies markers via (?<!-)\b(TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX)\b(?=[:\s]) regex, and requires CAM-\d+|#\d+|https?:// on the same line. 28 new tests. Gate added to GATES manifest as 'debt-markers' between file-size and ci-parity. Key gotcha: own file's comment 'TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers' trips the gate when XXX is followed by space; fixed by wrapping in parens '(TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX) markers'. Budget updated with _ref: CAM-60 tracker annotation. check:all 7 gates green.
